Landbook - Terms of Service, Website Submissions section
Landbook - PRO page / FAQ on getting featured

conditions: Free submission is gated by a curated editorial review - Landbook 'carefully picks' featured websites and most submissions are not accepted
Review takes from a few days up to one month depending on queue; silence for a month IS the rejection - no negative notification is sent
A free Landbook account is required to submit (submissions attach to a profile)
requirements: Live website URL - submissions are judged on current design trends, aesthetics, usability, accessibility, and content quality
Free Landbook account (sign up, verify account) - the submit control lives in the logged-in interface, not at a public URL
If submitting your own work, tick 'I'm the author of this website' - authored sites appear under your profile's 'Made' tab once the profile is public
You may submit sites you did not create (inspiration submissions appear without author attribution; the rightful creator can later claim them)
preparation: A website whose visual design can survive hand curation - functional but ordinary sites are declined
Confirmed rights: ticking the author box asserts you own the site or have explicit permission
Optional: pick a page type/category from their list
Nothing else - 'Landbook does not charge any money for submission'
workflow: Create a free account on land-book.com and verify it
In the logged-in interface, add the website (there is no public /submit URL - an independent guide notes /submit 404s)
Tick 'I'm the author of this website' if it is your own work
Wait up to one month; if featured, Landbook emails a heads-up; silence = rejection
watchFor: Rejection is silent - there is no status page or rejection email; a month without contact means 'not featured'
Spamming submissions violates the ToS and can get the account removed
Submitting someone else's site without ticking the author box is allowed, but the true creator can claim it later
A PRO tier exists but is not required for submission
countsAsLive: The website appears as a featured entry in the Landbook gallery (homepage/category pages) and, if authored, under your profile's 'Made' tab
unknowns: Current acceptance rate and exact queue length
Whether PRO members get any review priority
Whether the featured entry carries a dofollow link
